thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/28/2019: ZAYO, ENTG, VSM, GOOG, GOOGL, CTL, AUDC, AAPL, IBM, CSCO

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/28/2019: ZAYO, ENTG, VSM, GOOG, GOOGL, CTL, AUDC, AAPL, IBM, CSCO
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.34%
AAPL: -0.89%
IBM: -0.63%
CSCO: -0.61%
GOOG: Flat
Technology stocks were falling in Monday's pre-bell trading.
Stocks moving on news include:
(+) Entegris ( ENTG ) was over 5% higher after it agreed to merger of equals with Versum Matierals ( VSM ) to create a new specialty materials company for the semiconductor and high-tech industries. Under the terms of the deal, Versum shareholders will receive 1.12 shares of chemical and materials company Entegris for each share of Versum they already own.
(+) Zayo Group Holdings ( ZAYO ), which was up more than 4% after Bloomberg News reported that the company has drawn takeover interest from Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) and telecommunications firm CenturyLink ( CTL ).
(+) AudioCodes ( AUDC ) was almost 4% higher after booking Q4 adjusted profit of $0.20 per share, up from $0.12 per share in the prior-year period. The Street estimate from a single analyst was $0.17 per share.
